Fees: text grid on /registration/register-now. Abstract deadline: abstracts page 'November 17, 2026: Deadline for abstract submissions'. Venue: how-to-get page 'Venue Address : Lisbon Congress Centre'.

concerns: Hooks (Level 2), each proven by the harness: _edition_from (home lists the April 28 pre-course line first; family took it as the congress, giving 28 Apr start and city 'Pre-courses in Lisbon'); parse_place (strips 'X in' lead-in); fees_from_pages (text grid under category headings); apply_abstracts (family took 'Registration opens December 9, 2026' as the abstract deadline); venue_from_lines ('Venue Address : ...' has a space before the colon); detail_from_html (meta description replaces the 'Abstract submission closing soon' banner).

Robots: esgedays.org/robots.txt returns a soft 404 HTML page (noindex), no rules, so robots_gate allows all; never fetched esge.com. Pages fetched: home, register-now, abstracts, key-dates, how-to-get, general-terms PDF, imprint, plus 2 harness runs (about 20 requests total).

Terms: the site links only the participant and registration T&Cs (PDFs) and an imprint. Read the General T&Cs for Participants: no clause on robots, scraping, automated access or AI; only photo/recording rules. Imprint: none. The esge.com Terms of Use (automated access forbidden) were not fetched, as instructed.

Fees skipped on purpose: Press (free), Industry Representative badge (exhibitor/company staff), Postgraduate course industry rate, percentage-only rows (Least Developed Country 60% off, group 10% off). Add-on course prices exist only as late/on-site rates, with 'per course' for hands-on training. Members' fees are public (no login).
event_format is in_person although virtual participation is sold ('in Lisbon and online'); the family did not mark hybrid. Foreman may want hybrid.
Coverage checklist verified: multi-day range, Registration sub-page, abstract page with late-breaking dates, venue page. No external fee links, fee images or two-hop pages exist on this site.
Society code ESGE must exist in medconf-website/src/lib/taxonomy/societies.ts (the foreman owns registration).
